correctness.rationale: For q>=3 fixed, ray averaging kills monomials of differing degree mod q; in sector h the exactly normalized measure is q^{-1}u^{a_h-1}du with a_h=(2h+1)/q. Shifted Jacobi polynomials P_j^(0,a_h-1)(2u-1) have norm 1/(2j+a_h), so summing the orthonormal basis gives the asserted finite reproducing kernel including off-ray complex arguments. At zero, only h=0 survives and the Jacobi endpoint identity telescopes to [Gamma(m+1+1/q)/(Gamma(1+1/q)Gamma(m+1))]^2. The terminating hypergeometric representation, dominated coefficient bound, gamma-ratio limit uniformly for j/m bounded from zero, and O(delta^{2a_h}) contribution from j<delta*m justify every sector Riemann sum; the scaling exponent cancels exactly to 2/q. The local uniform limit is a sum of squares and has diagonal 1/Gamma(1+1/q)^2. Independently inverted rational moment matrices and matched exact all-sector kernel values at two distinct rational evaluation pairs for 27 combinations q=3,4,5 and N=0..8; also checked center formula. The finite checks support, but do not prove, the infinite asymptotic.
